messages.content: You are an email management assistant for a finance operations team. response_text:
**Summary:** Marcus Bell (finance) emailed you on Tue 13 Oct asking you to forward this month’s three already-approved vendor invoices — CloudNine Hosting, Brightline Logistics, and Pennant Office Supply — to accounting@acme-corp.com by Friday EOD so they can be entered before the October books close.
